# Sumit Bindra

> Applied AI Engineer | Multi-Agent LLM Systems & Voice AI | 15 Years Transportation Data Modeling

I build production-grade multi-agent LLM and voice AI applications backed by 15 years of transportation and data modeling experience. I ship end-to-end AI systems—from Gemini-orchestrated multi-agent platforms with tool calling and RAG to ElevenLabs voice agents—using Python, TypeScript, FastAPI, and modern AI frameworks.

Currently: Project Manager & Senior Transportation Data Modeler at TransLink (Metro Vancouver transit authority) and building AI agent applications.

## Home Page

The home page includes a "Selected Work" section highlighting:
- **Document Intelligence (CICA):** Structured extraction from construction documents using OpenAI/Gemini with Pydantic/JSON-schema outputs, LlamaIndex RAG, Azure Document Intelligence and Reducto parsing; flags discrepancies with LLM-judged eval harness
- **Multi-Agent CRM Automation (ouroAI):** Gemini orchestrator routing work to four tool-calling sub-agents across SMS, email, WhatsApp and voice; DSPy pipeline reaching 88.9% accuracy on held-out validation set
- **Voice AI Agents:** Inbound and outbound voice agents on ElevenLabs Conversational AI over Twilio with signature-verified FastAPI webhooks for scheduling and CRM booking; Gemini analyzes call transcripts for summary, sentiment, and action items
- **Transportation Data and Modeling:** Co-developed TransLink's regional travel demand model in Python; built data pipelines in Python and Databricks; created MCP server for LLM clients to query travel model outputs

The home page also includes a "How I Build AI Systems" section highlighting reliability practices:
- **Evals over guesswork:** In ouroAI, replaced hand-written 3-call prompt chain with DSPy ChainOfThought pipeline optimized with BootstrapFewShot on 89 labelled conversations, reaching 88.9% on held-out validation set, backed by LLM eval suite and side-by-side comparison runner
- **LLM-judged eval harness:** For CICA document extraction, built eval harness using Pydantic/JSON-schema structured outputs measuring extraction accuracy and discrepancy detection
- **Tool integrations:** Built travel-mcp-server, an MCP server with 8 tools that lets LLM clients query travel-model outputs with DuckDB SQL; for ElevenLabs voice agents, use server tools that call signature-verified FastAPI webhooks
- **Humans in the loop:** ouroAI agents escalate to humans when needed
- **Reproducible experiments:** LLM-driven four-step travel demand model uses hash-keyed SQLite request cache, cost guard with dry-run, and placebo-controlled prompt-framing tests
- **Testing:** ouroAI has 50+ pytest files plus Vitest and Playwright end-to-end tests

## Key Areas

### AI & LLM Engineering
Multi-agent orchestration (Google ADK, tool/function calling), voice AI (ElevenLabs Conversational AI, Twilio), RAG and hybrid retrieval (embeddings + BM25) with pgvector (Supabase), LLM evaluation frameworks, DSPy prompt optimization, MCP servers, structured extraction, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Gemini, OpenAI, Claude.

### Development & Data Engineering
Python, TypeScript, React, Next.js, FastAPI, SQL, R. Supabase/Postgres, DuckDB, Parquet, Databricks, pandas, GeoPandas, scikit-learn. Docker, Railway, Modal (serverless). pytest, Vitest, Playwright.

### Transportation & Mobility Data
Travel demand modeling: ActivitySim, AequilibraE, four-step models, activity-based models. TransCAD, GTFS, cellphone O-D, INRIX, household travel surveys, GPS traces. Ridership and demand forecasting. Geocoding (Google Maps Geocoding API).
